semiconductor_relevance: High — EKK Eagle Semicon Components provides specialized synthetic rubber components and elastomers critical for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: EKK Eagle Semicon Components specializes in engineered synthetic rubber solutions for the semiconductor industry. They produce their own monomers, allowing for precise control over the performance of their elastomers, which are used in various semiconductor manufacturing applications.
capabilities: Superior® elastomers such as FKM and FFKM
Bonded Gates VAT and Mono gate styles
